text: Scarborough Community Council will introduce bills.

General Bills Scarborough Community Council passed By-laws 147-2026 to 151-2026, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006. Confirmatory Bill Scarborough Community Council passed a Confirmatory Bill as By-law 152-2026, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006.
